hero.title: Communication, Reimagined.

hero.demoMsg1: Could you send over the updated design assets?
hero.demoMsg3: Received! The new glassmorphic theme looks stunning.

features.title: Everything you need for effortless communication
features.subtitle: Designed from the ground up for high reliability, zero latency, and seamless interaction across all your devices.
features.realTimeDesc: Sub-millisecond WebSocket data dispatch ensures instantaneous message delivery and updates without page refreshes.
features.secureDesc: Cryptographically hashed credentials with PBKDF2 and HMAC-SHA256 JWT tokens safeguarding each API and socket request.
features.groupsDesc: Organize discussions into focused groups with multi-member broadcasting, administrative controls, and activity tracking.
features.presenceDesc: Real-time presence engine updates online/away statuses and interactive typing indicators across all active users.
features.searchDesc: Find past conversations, direct contacts, and team members with client-side debounced search indexing.
features.themeDesc: Designed with bespoke dark mode tokens for comfortable night-time communication without jarring high-contrast glare.

security.title: Private conversations. Protected by design.
security.subtitle: FRANK is built on authoritative server-side validation, secure token handshakes, and strict data isolation to ensure confidentiality and integrity.
security.protectedDesc: Every request is authenticated through signed headers, preventing impersonation or unauthorized message snooping.
